# PulseFeed

> Real-time global and regional breaking news, trending stories, football updates, remote job listings, and creator monetization tools.

## Core Pages
- [PulseFeed Live Timeline](https://chukwumaadawuofor-ai.github.io/pulsefeed-engine/): Real-time breaking news, trending updates, and football feed across Nigeria (NG), UK, US, Europe (EU), Australia (AU), and Global.
- [Remote Jobs, Marketplace & Sponsorships](https://chukwumaadawuofor-ai.github.io/pulsefeed-engine/jobs.html): Curated remote work opportunities, digital offers, and sponsorship placements.
- [ViralHook AI Script Studio](https://chukwuma448.gumroad.com/l/dvfhm?utm_source=pulsefeed&utm_medium=social_auto&utm_campaign=viralhook_ai): Featured AI script and hook generator for faceless Shorts, Reels, and TikTok creators ($39+).
